title: Prop settings for the crypto-firm books (v7 on HyroTrader 2-Step, bf + index sleeve on BrightFunded 2-Step swap-free), nested
grid: challenge scale {1.0, 1.5, 2.0} x funded scale {0.75, 1.0, 1.5} x daily stop (fraction of the firm's daily loss limit) {0.5, 0.7} (x 15% vol; vol normaliser from 2022-24 only)
selection: max mean net 2-year P&L subject to P(profit) >= 0.90 on a block bootstrap (500 paths, block 20, budget 5) of 2022-01..2024-12 only
evaluation: chosen vs current (1.5 / 1.0 / 0.5 for v7; 1.5 / 1.0 / 0.6 for bf) on a bootstrap of 2025-01..2026-09 only; adopt only if mean net higher AND P(profit) not lower by more than 0.02
